question:
For a comparative politics study on descriptive representation, compile the share of women in the lower or single chamber of every member of the international organization that evolved from a mid-20th century European economic cooperation institution and is now headquartered in a historic castle in Paris, with its main members being developed market economies, at four benchmark dates: 31 Dec 1995, 31 Dec 2005, 31 Dec 2015, and 31 Dec 2024. Exclude upper chambers. Regarding the total seats, please provide the total number of seats in the lower parliament. If a country joined this organization after 1995, record 'NA' for all statistics for years before membership.

Please output one Markdown table with the columns, in this exact order:
Country | Share of Women Seats 1995(%) | Total Seats 1995 | Share of Women Seats 2005(%) | Total Seats 2005 | Share of Women Seats 2015(%) | Total Seats 2015 | Share of Women Seats 2024(%) | Total Seats 2024

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the column without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
